filter.comment: Episode = take (video_name, e.g. R0027-12-GoPro). Enumerate the 1758 annotation entries; emit only those with video+gaze (~1672). ~85 annotated takes lack video; ~439 video / ~464 gaze dirs are unannotated (likely held-out test, no labels here).

projection.notes: Gaze is a 3D ray: 9 tab cols = [rel_time_s, FILETIME_100ns, Px,Py,Pz (origin), Vx,Vy,Vz (direction, unit), valid]. rel_time_s = (FILETIME - VideoMp4Timing[0])/1e7, on the video clock (same as annotations). Project: transform ray to camera frame via per-frame 4x4 Pose_sync.txt, then apply psi Video/Intrinsics.txt (3x3 M + Brown-Conrady radial/tangential + FL/PP + W/H). RESOLVED: Video/Intrinsics.txt is W=896 H=504 = the pitchshift mp4 resolution exactly (verified on 5 takes; videoMetadata res uniformly 896x504), so NO rescale is needed (use FLx~681, FLy~682, PPx~445.4, PPy~237.4 directly on mp4 pixels). Do NOT use the sibling AhatDepth/Intrinsics.txt (512x512) — that is the depth camera. psi Intrinsics M maps camera coords -> NDC [-1,1]; for pixel mapping use FLx/FLy/PPx/PPy + W/H. Eyes.txt (non-sync) is NOT present; only Eyes_sync.txt.

join.comment: JSON is a list of 1758 take dicts {batch, videoMetadata, events, taskId, taskType, video_name}. events[] each {id,label,start,end,type,attributes}. Keep events with label=='Narration'.
Keep label=='Coarse grained action'; keep only the concatenated 'Action sentence' (drop Verb/Adjective/Noun).
Keep label=='Fine grained action'; preserve Verb, Adjective, Noun, Action Correctness.

video_metadata_rule.duration_s: (VideoMp4Timing[1] - VideoMp4Timing[0]) / 1e7  # authoritative; from video/<TAKE>/Video/VideoMp4Timing.txt FILETIME ticks. Do NOT use videoMetadata.duration.seconds (int-truncated).
video_metadata_rule.fps: videoMetadata.video.fps (per-take, NON-constant: 24.46, 30, ...). FALLBACK for takes absent from the trainval JSON (test split, e.g. R004-7July-GoPro, R006-7July-Switch): ffprobe avg_frame_rate of the mp4.
video_metadata_rule.resolution: 896x504 for all takes (videoMetadata.video.resolution == Intrinsics W,H; ffprobe-confirmed).

metadata.gaze_frame_mapping: Sidecar Pose_sync/Eyes_sync are a FIXED 30 Hz grid (col0 rel_time_sec, step 1/30, start 0.0), DECOUPLED from the mp4 fps. Map gaze->frame via TIME, never index: t = Eyes_sync.col0 (== (tick - VideoMp4Timing[0])/1e7); mp4_frame = round(t * fps). Naive index-equality drifts ~18% on 24.46fps takes.
metadata.notes: Per-take videoMetadata (896x504; fps 24.46 or 30) + taskType/taskId/batch in the annotation JSON. ffprobe cross-check: avg_frame_rate 24.4604 == shipped 24.46; 30.0017 == 30. No split list files on disk (single trainval JSON = train+val; test labels absent, ~85 annotated-elsewhere takes not in JSON).

provenance.notes: METADATA in annotation file. VIDEO dataset/video/<TAKE>/Video_pitchshift.mp4. GAZE dataset/gaze/<TAKE>/Eyes/Eyes_sync.txt (not 2D; de-risk mapping). ANNOTATION dataset/annotations/data-annotation-trainval-v1_1.json: Narration (Long form description), Coarse (Action sentence), Fine (Verb/Adjective/Noun/Action Correctness); drop label=Conversation. NOTE: Eyes pose = newline records of timestamp + 3D ray (origin P + direction V), tab-separated.
decisions: Episode = take (video_name); three annotation channels (narration, coarse, fine) all from one JSON, split by label; Conversation dropped (not enumerated).
Gaze preserved native as 3D head ray; projection NOW feasible via psi pinhole: Pose_sync.txt extrinsics + uploaded cam_info Intrinsics.txt.
rel_time_sec (col0) already on the video clock = annotation clock; no extra alignment file needed.
Fine text composed Verb+Adjective+Noun, with those + Action Correctness preserved as extras.
corrections: Only Eyes_sync.txt exists (no Eyes.txt); it has a leading rel_time_sec column before the FILETIME tick (9 cols total), unlike the notes' sketch.
Intrinsics do NOT ship in the base dataset; resolved by the user's cam_info/extracted/<take>/Export_py/Video/Intrinsics.txt upload (psi HoloLensCaptureExporter format) -> projection unblocked.
open_questions: Video/Intrinsics.txt resolution RESOLVED = 896x504 = mp4 resolution (no rescale needed); the only remaining projection unknown is the gaze ray reference frame (rig/world vs PV-camera) -- validate the Pose_sync.txt 4x4 composition end-to-end once projectaria_tools/cv2 are available.
~85 annotated takes have no video and 1 video lacks its mp4; build the episode set from annotation ∩ video-with-mp4 ∩ gaze.
fps is NOT uniform: videoMetadata shows 24.46 and 30 across takes (read per-take videoMetadata.video.fps; do not assume a constant).
